title: Fatigue and shortness of breath on exertion
personality: Calm, a little embarrassed to talk about periods, gives short answers
chief_complaint: I feel tired all the time, doctor, and I get out of breath on the stairs.
history_present_illness: For about four months I have been getting more and more tired. I get out of breath and my heart pounds when I climb to the third floor. I get dizzy when I stand up quickly. My hair falls out more than before and my nails break easily. For about a year my periods have been very heavy and last 7-8 days, I change pads every 1-2 hours on the first days. Recently I started wanting to chew ice.

symptoms.name: fatigue
symptoms.details: for about four months, getting worse

symptoms.name: shortness of breath and pounding heart
symptoms.details: only on exertion, for example on the stairs

symptoms.name: heavy periods
symptoms.details: for about a year, 7-8 days, very heavy on the first days

past_medical_history: Two pregnancies, two deliveries, the last one 3 years ago. No chronic diseases. No operations.
medications: Nothing regularly. Took vitamins for a month last year.
family_history: Mother had 'low haemoglobin' in her youth. No blood diseases known.
social_history: Does not smoke, no alcohol. Eats meat rarely, mostly bread, pasta and tea. Office work.

test_results.General inspection: Pale skin and conjunctivae. Dry skin, brittle spoon-shaped nails (koilonychia). Angular cheilitis. No jaundice, no lymphadenopathy.
test_results.Heart auscultation: Tachycardia, soft systolic murmur at the apex, not radiating.
test_results.Complete blood count: Hb 84 g/L, RBC 3.4 ×10¹²/L, MCV 68 fL, MCH 21 pg, RDW 18%, reticulocytes 0.8%, WBC 6.1 ×10⁹/L, platelets 410 ×10⁹/L. Smear: hypochromia, microcytosis, anisocytosis.
test_results.Serum iron and ferritin: Serum iron 4.2 µmol/L (ref 9-30), ferritin 5 ng/mL (ref 15-150), total iron-binding capacity 82 µmol/L (increased), transferrin saturation 5%.
test_results.Blood biochemistry: Bilirubin, ALT, AST, creatinine within normal limits.
test_results.Abdominal ultrasound: No abnormalities of liver, spleen, kidneys. Uterus slightly enlarged, small intramural myoma 2 cm.
